sources.author: Harrison Chase
sources.headline: Co-founder & CEO @ LangChain
sources.post_summary: Discussed the rapid evolution of AI agents from simple chains to autonomous systems capable of multi-step reasoning and tool use. Highlighted how developer tooling around memory, planning, and evaluation is becoming critical infrastructure for production agents.

sources.author: Simon Willison
sources.headline: Independent AI researcher & creator of Datasette
sources.post_summary: Shared practical insights on building reliable AI automation pipelines using open-source tools. Emphasized the importance of observability, error handling, and human-in-the-loop design when deploying agents in real workflows.

sources.author: Swyx
sources.headline: Founder @ Latent.Space & AI Engineer
sources.post_summary: Explored the emerging AI infrastructure stack, comparing current agent frameworks to early cloud computing layers. Argued that standardized evaluation benchmarks and deployment patterns are the next bottleneck for widespread adoption.

sources.author: Clemens Tiedt
sources.headline: Engineering @ Replit
sources.post_summary: Posted about new AI-native developer tools at Replit that integrate autonomous agents into the IDE. Showed real examples of agents writing, testing, and deploying code with minimal human oversight.

sources.author: Elena Voss
sources.headline: GTM Engineer @ Ramp | Ex-Salesforce
sources.post_summary: Discussed building a GTM engineering function that sits between product and sales, using data pipelines to score ICP fit and trigger personalized outbound sequences. Shared how her team reduced time-to-first-meeting by 40% by instrumenting product usage signals into outreach.

sources.author: Marcus Hale
sources.headline: Head of Revenue Operations @ Notion
sources.post_summary: Explained how his RevOps team automated lead enrichment and routing using a custom stack (Clay + n8n + Salesforce). Highlighted a 3x increase in qualified pipeline after implementing intent-based triggers instead of static lists.

sources.author: Priya Sharma
sources.headline: Founder @ GrowthOS | GTM Advisor
sources.post_summary: Shared a content-to-pipeline framework where SEO and LinkedIn content are scored by downstream conversion metrics rather than vanity metrics. Detailed how her team built attribution models tying content consumption to closed-won revenue.

sources.author: David Kwon
sources.headline: Director, Sales Operations @ Deel
sources.post_summary: Posted about operationalizing outbound at scale: how his team uses AI to generate personalized email variants and A/B tests them in real time. Shared results showing 28% higher reply rates with dynamic personalization vs static templates.

sources.author: Lila Chen
sources.headline: GTM Systems Architect @ Rippling
sources.post_summary: Wrote about the evolution from traditional sales ops to GTM engineering, emphasizing building internal tooling that connects CRM, product analytics, and enrichment data. Included a diagram of their signal-to-sequence architecture.

sources.author: Pieter Levels
sources.headline: Founder @ Nomad List & Remote OK | Solo founder shipping products
sources.post_summary: Shared his latest solo-built product update: launched a new AI travel tool in 4 days using no-code + custom code. Discussed how he validates ideas quickly by shipping MVPs publicly and iterating based on real user feedback instead of over-planning.

sources.author: Danny Postma
sources.headline: Founder & Builder | Ex-Meta | Shipping AI products
sources.post_summary: Posted about pivoting from a failed SaaS to a new AI image tool. Detailed the exact tech stack, launch metrics, and how going public with weekly progress updates helped him gain early users and feedback loops.

sources.author: Arvid Kahl
sources.headline: Author & Indie Founder | Bootstrapped to exit
sources.post_summary: Wrote about his transition from corporate engineering to full-time indie building. Shared lessons from shipping multiple micro-SaaS products and the importance of consistent public updates to stay accountable and attract collaborators.

sources.author: Marc Lou
sources.headline: Solo Founder | ShipFast & 20+ products
sources.post_summary: Documented shipping his 3rd product this quarter in public. Broke down the 10-day build process, revenue numbers from day one, and how transparent weekly threads helped him get early paying customers without traditional marketing.

sources.author: Santiago Valdarrama
sources.headline: ML Engineer turned Founder | Building AI tools
sources.post_summary: Shared his pivot story from big tech ML role to solo founder. Posted about building an open-source AI dev tool in public, including code snippets, user growth charts, and the challenges of balancing product work with community engagement.
